role: The Recovery Report screen for one session (morning results / history detail): hero score, readiness, HRV/sleep cards, training load, overnight charts with the window picker, data-source card, summary, tags and actions; sheets for score explainer (RecoveryScoreExplainerSheet), PDF preview and mail (RecoveryReportMailComposer); the unreadable-reading state (UnreadableReadingState); delete/discard/reanalyze/window-method/unlink dialogs and the declined-reanalysis alert; lifecycle hydration and archive/sleep refresh.
types: LinkedSegmentInfo: struct — id/start/end of one split-night segment
MorningResultsView: struct View — the report screen; owns @State MorningResultsViewModel and UI state
IdentifiableURL: struct (Equatable) — Identifiable wrapper (fresh UUID) around a URL for .sheet(item:)
SavedTagsAndNotes: struct (Equatable) — tag set + notes text last handed to onUpdateTags
ReportFileSheet: enum (Identifiable) — the report's one file sheet: .preview(IdentifiableURL) or .mail(IdentifiableURL)
state: @State vm: MorningResultsViewModel; exportURL, emailURL, showingReanalyzeConfirmation, isManualWindowMode, manualResult, showReportSectionPicker, showEmailSectionPicker, showingDeleteConfirmation, showingDiscardConfirmation, pendingWindowMethod (Analysis Window pick awaiting confirmation), reanalysisDeclined, showingUnlinkConfirmation, pendingUnlinkSegmentId, removedSegmentIds, segmentUnlinkFailed, exportErrorMessage, savedTagsAndNotes, manualPickMessage, strapMergeWorking, strapMergeMessage, showingScoreExplainer, sleepAdjustedHere (view-local)
toplevel: Stored callbacks onDiscard/onDelete/onReanalyze/onUpdateTags/onReanalyzeAt/onApplyManualResult/onUpdateSleep/onAdjustSleep/onUnlinkSegment (returns whether the unlink was stored), discardMessage (what the Discard confirmation says is lost; nil falls back to a plain line) and linkedSegments are set by the init; IdentifiableURL.id is a new UUID per wrapper.

units.does: Stores all inputs and callbacks (onUnlinkSegment returns whether the unlink was stored; discardMessage is the caller's Discard-confirmation text, default nil) and creates the MorningResultsViewModel(session:result:recentSessions:) as @State.
units.entry: Called by RecordView+Sections, HistoryView, ImportDataView and BigScreenSnapshotTests.

units.does: Attaches two sheets: the score explainer (RecoveryScoreExplainerSheet, whose Done clears showingScoreExplainer), and ONE item sheet for the report's files (reportFileSheetBinding) showing the PDF/CSV preview for .preview or the mail composer for .mail, since two stacked item sheets can drop the second.

Binding for the report's file sheet: .preview(exportURL) when an export is set, else .mail(emailURL), else nil. Setting nil clears the one shown (exportURL first), which also deletes its file (withExportHandling).

Destructive 'Delete' (calls onDelete) and Cancel buttons.

Discard confirmation actions: destructive 'Discard' records the current Tags & Notes edits as handled (savedTagsAndNotes, so neither this nor the sheet's onDisappear hands a save off for a reading about to be rejected or deleted) and calls onDiscard(); Cancel does nothing.
calls: closure:onDiscard — set by callers (RecordView dismissMorningReading, ImportDataView discardImport, RecordView discardQuickReading)

units.does: Discard confirmation message: the caller's discardMessage, or 'This discards the reading.' when it is nil.
Message saying the reading moves to Trash restorable from Settings → iCloud & Data → Trash.
'Re-analyze' (performReanalysis) and Cancel buttons.
Message that re-analysis re-runs on the reading's beat data and saves the new score in place of the current one, without changing the beat data.
Bool binding for the window-method confirmation: true while pendingWindowMethod is set; setting false clears it.
units.entry: SwiftUI reads/writes it through the confirmationDialog

units.does: Window-method confirmation actions: 'Re-analyze' clears pendingWindowMethod and runs MorningReanalysisControls.applyWindowMethod(method); Cancel clears pendingWindowMethod.

Window-method confirmation message naming the method: for a past night, it re-scores that reading and replaces its score; otherwise it re-scores and replaces the score and new readings will also use the method. Both say the beat data is not changed.

branches.effect: true → past-reading text; false → text that also names the new default

units.does: Destructive 'Remove' (unlinkPendingSegment) and Cancel (clears pendingUnlinkSegmentId) buttons.

Clears the pending segment id and calls onUnlinkSegment with it. Only when that reports the unlink stored is the segment hidden from the list (animated unless Reduce Motion); otherwise it stays listed and segmentUnlinkFailed raises the "couldn't remove" alert.

branches.effect: segmentUnlinkFailed = true and return; the segment stays listed
nil animation vs easeInOut 0.2 s while inserting into removedSegmentIds

units.does: Message explaining the segment will be unlinked from analysis.

Adds .task hydrateAndLoad and onChange observers: sleepDataVersion -> refetch sleep; archiveSignal.version -> vm.applyExternalArchiveUpdate; and onDisappear -> saveTagsAndNotesIfChanged, so tag/note edits survive a swipe-dismiss or a parent's own Done.

When exportURL or emailURL is replaced or cleared (its preview or mail sheet closed), deletes the previous file from tmp via removeExportFile — the RR CSV and recovery PDF are plaintext health data. Presents the 'Export failed' alert with exportErrorMessage while it is set; OK clears it.

branches.effect: alert shown; dismiss sets it nil

units.does: Deletes the old export file when there was one and it is not the new value (same id); a failed delete is logged by attempt.
For today's session that the user has not adjusted here or in storage, re-runs vm.fetchHealthKitSleep in a Task.
Sets vm.baselineStats from the collector's scoring baseline, wires vm.onUpdateSleep, hydrates a lightweight session, then vm.loadInitialData().
When the displayed session has no RR points, resolves the archive on the main actor, retrieves the full session from it on a detached task and, if it has RR points, puts it into vm.reanalyzedSession.
